# a map of consciousness

> unofficial map of ideas about mind and consciousness that joscha bach has mentioned in public. AI-made and model-checked, not checked by a person; joscha bach didn't make or approve it.

- [the whole map as markdown](https://maxeozakh.github.io/bach-map/map.md): every point, summary, confidence level, connection and source
- [how to read it and where it comes from](https://maxeozakh.github.io/bach-map/about.html)
- [interactive map](https://maxeozakh.github.io/bach-map/)
